n: Ultraman Shopping Street, Soshigaya (ウルトラマン商店街)
address: North of Soshigaya-Ōkura Station (Odakyū line), Soshigaya, Setagaya-ku, Tokyo
w: The everyday shopping street running north from Soshigaya-Ōkura Station is decked out with Ultraman statues and street lamps — Tsuburaya Productions, the studio behind Ultraman, was headquartered nearby.
anime: Ultraman — tokusatsu hero honoured by the street beside Tsuburaya Productions' former home

n: Anime Tokyo Station, Ikebukuro (アニメ東京ステーション)
w: Opened October 2023 as Tokyo's official anime hub: a free basement archive of ~50,000 production items — layouts, storyboards, original drawings and cels rarely shown publicly — plus rotating exhibitions.
anime: Cross-franchise — the Metropolitan Government-backed anime archive (current shows: Digimon Adventure 02 & Ojamajo Doremi 25th anniversary)
sts: GO TOKYO spot page; Tokyo Cheapo exhibition listing Nov 2025–Feb 2026

n: Tokyo Anime Center, DNP Plaza Shibuya (東京アニメセンター)
address: DNP Plaza Shibuya 2F, Jinnan, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo
w: Formerly in Akihabara and then Ichigaya, the Tokyo Anime Center now runs rotating anime, manga and game exhibitions with AR/VR on the second floor of DNP Plaza Shibuya; the shop is free to enter.
anime: Rotating franchise exhibitions — the long-running official anime promotion centre

n: Toei Animation Museum, Ōizumi (東映アニメーションミュージアム)
address: Toei Animation Ōizumi Studio, Higashi-Ōizumi, Nerima-ku, Tokyo
w: Inside Toei Animation's Ōizumi studio in Nerima — the birthplace of Dragon Ball, Sailor Moon, One Piece and Pretty Cure — with exhibits on the studio's history and production.
anime: Toei Animation — Dragon Ball, Sailor Moon, One Piece, Precure; museum in the working studio

dish: Kirby-shaped burgers and pizza; each dish comes with a gift (plate, figurine, coaster or mug)
n: Kirby Café Tokyo, Tokyo Solamachi (カービィカフェ)
address: Tokyo Solamachi 4F, Tokyo Skytree Town, Oshiage, Sumida-ku, Tokyo
w: Nintendo's pink hero gets his own café on Solamachi's fourth floor under Skytree — Kirby-shaped burgers and pizza, most dishes and drinks served with a collectible, plus an exclusive-goods shop.
anime: Kirby (Nintendo / HAL Laboratory) — the official character café
